about.heroHeading: Sakafat Global is a Pakistan-rooted media and production company developing cultural content, dialogue, creative formats and participation pathways.

belief.tail: Our work connects cultural understanding with responsible media, creative production and practical opportunity.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.body: To use media, production and dialogue to strengthen values, understanding, connection, opportunity and cultural heritage.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.body: To establish culture as a dynamic socioeconomic force, where Pakistani heritage and creative dialogue inspire confidence, connection and opportunity across generations.

promises.title: Honest Communication
promises.detail: We never publish misleading deadlines, false availability, or fabricated participation tiers. Every open call, deadline, fee structure, and eligibility criterion is disclosed accurately before registration opens.

promises.title: Privacy & Context
promises.text: We respect personal data and cultural sensitivity.
promises.detail: Personal contact details and contributor materials are kept secure and confidential. Cultural narratives, indigenous oral histories, and community traditions are contextualized with utmost respect and community consultation.

promises.title: Transparent Content
promises.text: We identify sponsored and commissioned work.
promises.detail: We maintain clear separation between independent editorial production and commercial or institutional sponsorships. All supported, funded, or branded media carries unambiguous disclosures for complete audience trust.

promises.title: Rights & Consent
promises.text: We protect contributors and creative ownership.
promises.detail: Artists, writers, musicians, and filmmakers retain moral and intellectual rights to their original creations. We establish fair licensing agreements and obtain informed consent prior to recording, broadcasting, or publishing.

promises.title: English & Urdu
promises.text: We design meaningful experiences in both languages.
promises.detail: Both English and Urdu are treated as primary languages of dialogue and cultural transmission. We invest in high-calibre translation, Nastaliq typography, and native cultural expressions rather than automated machine translations.

promises.title: Impact With Purpose
promises.text: We measure value beyond views and followers.
promises.detail: Success is evaluated through depth of understanding, long-term educational relevance, and the tangible cultural capabilities fostered within communities—not fleeting viral metrics or sensationalism.

about.statement: Sakafat Global operates as a private media and production company. It is not represented as a government authority, charity, broadcaster, legal adviser or nationally representative research institution.

editorialCharter.title: Editorial Charter
editorialCharter.intro: Our editorial standards, cultural commitments, and principles of integrity guiding every production, narrative, and dialogue.

sections.title: Cultural Integrity & Heritage
sections.content: Sakafat Global is committed to representing Pakistan's diverse regional cultures, traditions, and artistic heritage with authenticity, nuance, and historical accuracy. We reject superficial caricatures and prioritize voices rooted in lived community experience.

sections.title: Editorial Independence
sections.content: Our creative decisions and intellectual pursuits are free from external commercial or partisan influences. Our editorial board evaluates proposals based on artistic merit, public value, ethical grounding, and alignment with our foundational pillars.

sections.title: Research & Factual Rigour
sections.content: Every documentary, podcast, article, and educational programme undergoes thorough fact-checking and contextual research. When presenting contested histories or complex cultural discourses, we provide balanced perspectives and transparent sourcing.

sections.title: Respect & Inclusivity
sections.content: We foster open dialogue that honours diverse viewpoints while upholding fundamental human dignity. We do not tolerate hate speech, incitement, or discrimination based on gender, ethnicity, religion, or background.

sections.title: Corrections & Accountability
sections.content: We believe transparency builds trust. When substantive factual errors occur, we correct them promptly, clearly, and visibly across all affected platforms and media releases.

contactNote.heading: Questions or Editorial Feedback
contactNote.body: If you have questions about our editorial standards or wish to request a correction, please reach out to our editorial team.

privacy.title: Privacy Notice
privacy.intro: How Sakafat Global collects, uses, protects, and respects your personal information across our website and digital services.

sections.title: Information We Collect
sections.content: We collect information you provide directly to us when you submit an enquiry form, register an account, apply for a programme, or subscribe to updates. This includes your name, email address, phone number, organization, and any message or portfolio attachments.

sections.title: How We Use Your Information
sections.content: We use your data solely to respond to your enquiries, process programme applications, manage your account session, provide access to collaborative tools, and communicate important updates regarding our productions and events.

sections.title: Cookies & Authentication
sections.content: We use essential cookies to maintain secure authentication sessions and remember your language preference (English or Urdu). We do not use invasive third-party tracking or advertising cookies.

sections.title: Media & Third-Party Services
sections.content: Our platform links to and embeds external media services such as YouTube to provide video playback. These services may collect viewer telemetry according to their own privacy policies when you interact with their players.

sections.title: Data Security & Retention
sections.content: Your data is stored securely in encrypted databases and protected using industry-standard security protocols. We retain your information only as long as necessary to fulfill the purpose for which it was gathered or as required by law.

sections.title: Your Rights
sections.content: You have the right to access, rectify, or request the deletion of your personal data at any time. You may also withdraw consent for communications by contacting us.

contactNote.heading: Data Protection Inquiries
contactNote.body: To exercise your data privacy rights or ask questions regarding our data practices, please contact our data protection team.

accessibility.title: Accessibility Statement
accessibility.intro: Our ongoing commitment to ensuring an inclusive, barrier-free digital experience for all visitors, creators, and participants.

sections.title: Conformance Standard
sections.content: Sakafat Global strives to conform with the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 Level AA standards. We regularly audit and refine our interface to ensure our content is accessible to users with varied abilities and assistive technologies.

sections.title: Bilingual & RTL Layout Architecture
sections.content: Our website provides first-class support for both English (LTR) and Urdu (RTL). For Urdu, we employ authentic Noto Nastaliq typography with calibrated line heights and proportional font scaling, ensuring comfortable reading without descender collisions.

sections.title: Keyboard Navigation & Focus
sections.content: All interactive elements, including navigation menus, forms, accordion panels, and dialogue triggers, are fully navigable via keyboard. High-contrast focus indicators are maintained across light and dark backgrounds.

sections.title: Visual Contrast & Motion Preferences
sections.content: Color palettes are designed to meet or exceed WCAG AA contrast ratios for text and graphical elements. We respect the user's prefers-reduced-motion system preference by disabling non-essential decorative animations.

sections.title: Assistive Technologies & Semantic HTML
sections.content: We build with semantic HTML5 elements and appropriate ARIA attributes, ensuring that screen readers and assistive tools can accurately interpret document structure, landmarks, form fields, and status messages.

contactNote.heading: Accessibility Feedback
contactNote.body: If you experience any accessibility barriers on our site or have suggestions for improvement, we welcome your feedback.

criteria.heading: What We Look For
criteria.intro: Every proposal and partnership is evaluated against four foundational standards.

items.title: Pillar Alignment
items.description: Projects must resonate with one of our five pillars: Ikhlakiat, Idraak, Hayya Alal Falah, Rabta, or Sama.

items.title: Cultural Authenticity
items.description: Grounding in genuine community relationships, avoiding stereotypes, and honouring local historical contexts.

items.title: Ethical Sourcing & Consent
items.description: Fair compensation, transparent credits, and informed consent for all interviewees and traditional culture bearers.

items.title: Original Voice & Craft
items.description: Distinctive creative vision, compelling narrative structure, and high standards of visual and technical execution.
